message.content: A vertical editorial illustration on a magazine cover features two men standing in an overgrown field before a large white building with columns. The taller man in the foreground has dark hair, a beard, and wears a dark vest over a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt. Behind him, a slightly shorter man in glasses and a light-colored shirt looks over his shoulder toward the viewer. Farther back, a small silhouette of a third person stands atop the building’s flat roof. The building is a symmetrical, white stone structure with a colonnade and two side wings. In the lower corners, blurred dark green shapes resemble car parts, including a side-view mirror. The sky is filled with dark, swirling grey clouds. Large red text at the top reads "TEMPO" above the tagline "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Smaller white text titles include "PANAS-ADEM JOKOWI-NASDEM", "Duit Lukas Enembe di Senjata Ilegal Papua H.76", and "Pemburu Rente Beras Murah H.86". A barcode, QR code, and price information are in the upper right. The overall color palette is muted with greys, whites, and dark greens, contrasted by the bold red masthead.
